description: Verify that the Customer User does not have access to the Create Service Report option anywhere in the application.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Service Reports module
Check for the presence of any Create or New Service Report button
expected_result: The Create or New Service Report button is not visible to the Customer User anywhere in the application.

title: CU cannot access Create SR via direct URL
description: Ensure that a Customer User cannot access the Create Service Report form by navigating directly to its URL.
steps_summary: Directly navigate to the Create Service Report URL
expected_result: The Customer User receives a 'Not Authorized' error or is redirected; no Service Report creation form is displayed.

title: Unauthenticated user cannot access Create SR URL
description: Verify that an unauthenticated user cannot access the Create Service Report form by navigating directly to its URL.
steps_summary: Navigate directly to the Create Service Report URL without being logged in
expected_result: User is redirected to the login page or sees a 'Not Authorized' error message.

title: Agent cannot fetch eligible service report forms for a ticket they do not have access to
description: Verify that an agent who is not assigned, accountable, creator, collaborator, or in the ticket's department cannot fetch eligible service report forms for a ticket.
preconditions: Agent is logged in
Agent is not assigned, accountable, creator, or collaborator on the ticket
Agent does not have department access to the ticket's department
steps_summary: Call the /reports/form/options endpoint with a ticket_id for which the agent has no access
expected_result: API returns a 403 Forbidden error with message: "You do not have permission to access this ticket" and does not return any form options.
prd_references: PRD: Service Report Access Control — Only agents with explicit access to the ticket may view or create service reports or related forms.

title: Agent who is a collaborator but not in ticket department can fetch eligible service report forms
description: Verify that an agent who is a collaborator on a ticket (but not assigned/accountable/creator or in the department) can fetch eligible service report forms for that ticket.
preconditions: Agent is logged in
Agent is a collaborator on the ticket
Agent is not assigned, accountable, creator, or in the ticket's department
steps_summary: Call the /reports/form/options endpoint with a ticket_id for which the agent is a collaborator
expected_result: API returns eligible service report forms for the ticket, including forms and default_form_id.
prd_references: PRD: Service Report Access Control — Collaborators have access to ticket-linked forms.

title: Agent who is assigned/accountable/creator on ticket but not in department can fetch eligible service report forms
description: Verify that an agent who is assigned, accountable, or creator on a ticket (but not in the department) can fetch eligible service report forms for that ticket.
preconditions: Agent is logged in
Agent is assigned, accountable, or creator on the ticket
Agent is not a collaborator and not in the ticket's department
steps_summary: Call the /reports/form/options endpoint with a ticket_id for which the agent is assigned/accountable/creator
expected_result: API returns eligible service report forms for the ticket, including forms and default_form_id.
prd_references: PRD: Service Report Access Control — Assignment, accountability, or creator status grants access to ticket-linked forms.

title: No eligible service report forms returned if ticket has no service type
description: Verify that if a ticket does not have a service_type set, the /reports/form/options endpoint returns an empty forms array and null default_form_id.
preconditions: Agent is logged in
Agent has access to the ticket
Ticket does not have a service_type set
steps_summary: Call the /reports/form/options endpoint with a ticket_id for a ticket with no service_type
expected_result: API returns { forms: [], default_form_id: null }.
prd_references: PRD: Service Report Form Selection — Only tickets with a service type can have eligible forms.
